author: r1-O2
rationale: Hand-built grammar model: a recurrent one-hot grammar state (phase x agreement stack of pending verb numbers x clause index) is updated by word-completion events detected from the ctx window; a prefix detector bank identifies the partial word; next-char logits are a lookup over (distribution class x prefix) computed from hand-typed word lists and hand-estimated structural probabilities; eos after '.' uses a step-length ramp.
